baseline.scope: Frozen complete original displayTerritories method; executed with real unmodified border-curves and boundary-mesh.

method: Actual candidate AtlasMap/BoundaryController and unmodified native loader, exact local 1492 pack, frozen original display method oracle, and actual MapLibre 5.6.2 GeoJSONSource/GeoJSONWorkerSource with structured-clone actor boundaries. Native data transport is local file-backed. This is not browser rendering, network latency, or first-load acceleration evidence.

checks.name: A full real 1492 frame is byte-identical to the frozen original, while same-year language commits reuse derivation and skip settled LD
Changed properties, feature ordering and replacement geometry references invalidate the one-frame cache
Raw, curved and CShapes portrayal remain byte-identical to the old method and never accumulate synthetic features
Explicit invalidation rebuilds the existing portrayal WeakMaps even for in-place raw-coordinate edits
External setData on the same real source invalidates ownership; same-year display restores the intended frame
Style replacement with a new actual source resubmits the existing exact derivation and detaches the retired observer
An actual source failure forces a later same-input retry instead of treating the failed submission as loaded
Owned A in flight then owned B remains correct through real MapLibre queued _data replacement
External A in flight then owned B remains correct through real MapLibre queued _data replacement
An external queued updateData diff is superseded by a later same-year frame even while _data still has the owned reference
Rapid curve toggles during a real in-flight submission settle on the last exact portrayal
Overlapping year requests keep the existing AtlasMap stale-result guard and do not cache an old late frame
Dual maps own independent submissions and destroying one releases only its cache and source listeners
Source observers detach and explicit invalidation leaves no collection or payload retained
